guide.setup: Lie with eyes under the bar, feet planted, shoulder blades pulled together, and hands just wider than shoulder width.
guide.execution: Unrack over the shoulders, lower with control to the lower chest, then press up and slightly back until the elbows lock.
guide.cues: Stay tight through the upper back. Keep wrists over elbows. Drive through the feet.
guide.mistakes: Bouncing the bar; flaring elbows straight out; lifting the hips; losing shoulder-blade tension.
